headline: Voyager 1 reaches calculated one-light-day distance from Earth
caption: SPACE MILESTONE | NASA calculated that Voyager 1 reached a distance of one light-day from Earth at 10:16 UTC (3:46 PM IST) on 18 November 2026. That is roughly 25.9 billion km: light or radio signals take 24 hours to travel one way. Reuters reports NASA awaits the next signal before confirming the milestone. Sources: NASA/JPL https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/voyager-1-what-is-a-light-day/ and Reuters https://www.reuters.com/science/nasa-voyager-1-probe-believed-have-reached-light-day-milestone-2026-11-18/ .
